blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Labor and Employment (Dole) is introducing an online portal that will allow employers to submit their wage compliance reports digitally, giving the agency a more efficient way to monitor establishments implementing approved minimum wage increases. Under the system, employers are encouraged to voluntarily submit their wage compliance reports through the portal, allowing Dole to identify establishments that have complied with prevailing wage orders and those that may require further verification. “Under the new mechanism, employers are encouraged to submit their wage compliance reports through Dole’s online compliance portal,” the department said.
